<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1264
Claimant:
Richard Randall
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
05/21/2023
Claim opened for a parking lot collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck while parked in a marked space. The
claimant reports a shoulder injury from the impact and states they are not represented by a lawyer.
05/29/2023
Confirmed that the driver involved is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of the incident.
Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the coverage period.
06/14/2023
Obtained the police report and two witness statements, both of which place the claimant inside the vehicle at the time
of contact and describe the collision as the claimant described it.
06/27/2023
Reviewed photos from the scene and the other driver's statement. The damage pattern on both vehicles lines up with
the impact as reported, and no earlier damage to the claimant's vehicle appears in our records.
07/24/2023
Spoke with the claimant again to walk through the sequence of events. The account matched what was given in the
first call, with the same details about where the impact occurred and how the other vehicle approached.
09/04/2023
Medical records were requested. The shoulder injury is consistent with the type of impact described, and no prior
treatment to that body area appears in the claimant's history.
10/15/2023
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this kind of shoulder injury. The file is being monitored
and the provider has been asked for updated notes on the treatment plan.
12/17/2023
Reviewed the file as a whole. The accident, vehicle damage, policy status and driver identity are all supported, and
the claim remains open pending the updated treatment notes.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
